# The fixture site's instructions to automated visitors.
#
# Real, not decorative: the agent's politeness tests read this file over HTTP
# exactly as they would read a real site's, so the rules below are what
# "respects robots.txt" is asserted against.
#
# `/ledger.html` is excluded deliberately. It is a real page, reachable, and
# linked from the home page — which is the only interesting case. A rule that
# excluded a path nobody could reach anyway would pass whether the agent read
# this file or not.

User-agent: *
Disallow: /ledger.html
Disallow: /private/
Crawl-delay: 2
